antenna_mast.notes: triangular lattice radio mast 1200 tall on a concrete pad; red/white painted bands (vertex colours), red beacon (glow) at the top

barrel_toxic.notes: green toxic drum 60 dia x 90, leaking glowing liquid (glow map) + puddle

blast_door_frame.notes: blast door 300 wide x 60 deep x 300 tall (opening 200x240) with the heavy slab CLOSED; collision blocks the doorway; red warning lamps (add LIGH if wanted)

blast_door_open.notes: same frame with the slab retracted into the lintel (only its hazard-striped lip shows); doorway 200x240 walkable

blood_splat_floor.notes: blood splatter decal quad 120x120, 0.4 above the floor, alpha blended + decal flag, no collision

blood_splat_wall.notes: blood splatter wall decal 100x100; origin on the wall surface at the splat centre, 0.4 off the wall, no collision

broken_terminal.notes: smashed CRT terminal (for tables/desks): cracked screen opening, glass shards, sparking (additive spark cards)

bunker_entrance.notes: exterior concrete bunker block 700x500x400 (z=-100..300, 100 sunk below grade) with a framed 256x256 doorway recess on +Y (recess back wall at y=186: place the facility load door there). Collision on all solid parts

catwalk_256.notes: metal grating catwalk 256 (X) x 128 (Y) with railings on both long sides; origin at the CENTRE OF THE WALKING SURFACE (z=0), frame hangs to z=-14. Tiles every 256 along X. Walkable box collision + railing walls

catwalk_stairs.notes: grating stairs 128 wide rising 256 over 384 toward +Y: bottom edge at y=-192 (z=0), top at y=+192 (z=256, meets catwalk_256 surface). 16 steps (rise 16, run 24). Collision: walkable ramp hull + handrail walls

chainlink_fence.notes: chain-link fence panel 256 wide x 250 tall (+ barbed wire to 275) along X (-128..128), alpha-tested double-sided mesh; posts are separate (fence_post at x=+-128)

checkpoint_booth.notes: enterable guard booth 250x250x280: door opening (90x210) in the +X wall, window over a counter on the +Y wall, side window on -X wall; collision on walls/glass/roof/floor/counter. Navmesh inside: use `cutouts` (wall rects), not the whole footprint

console_bank.notes: floor-standing wall console 200x60x110, back against wall at y=-30; sloped control panel + 2 glow screens. Origin at base centre.

containment_tank.notes: specimen containment tank, 90 dia x 230; glass tube (alpha blend, double sided), glowing liquid column

containment_tank_broken.notes: broken containment tank: jagged glass remnants, empty, liquid puddle on base and floor

crate_stack.notes: two large crates side by side + one small crate on top

debris_pile.notes: pile of broken concrete chunks, rebar and bent metal sheets ~190x160x60

desk_terminal.notes: office desk 120x60x52 with CRT terminal (glow screen) and keyboard; user side +Y

fence_post.notes: steel fence post r=4, 250 tall, with barbed-wire arm leaning to -Y (to 275) and concrete footing; place at chainlink_fence panel ends

floodlight_tripod.notes: portable floodlight on a tripod, 230 tall, lamp faces +Y tilted down 15 deg; glowing lens. Add a spot LIGH near (0,25,215)

fluorescent_ceiling.notes: ceiling light panel 120x30; CEILING-MOUNTED: origin on the ceiling surface, hangs down to z=-8; glowing diffuser faces -Z. Add a LIGH at about (0,0,-20)

generator.notes: diesel-style generator 220x120x150 on a skid; control panel (glow) on +Y side

guard_tower.notes: steel watch tower 400x400 base, wooden platform floor at z=610 (340x340) with half walls/railing, roof to 850, ladder on +Y side (no ladder collision). Ground under the tower is walkable: use `cutouts` (the 4 feet)

lab_table.notes: metal lab bench 140x70x55 with lower shelf; top surface z=55

locker.notes: metal locker 50x45x190, door on +Y (static mesh, use as CONT model)

meteor_crystal_large.notes: glowing crystal cluster ~400 tall on a charred rock base; crystals use the glow-map shader + additive halo shells. Add a cyan LIGH nearby

meteor_rock.notes: charred meteor chunk ~500x400x250 with glowing crystal veins (glow map) and a few crystal spikes; sunk ~25 units into the ground (bounds z<0)

overturned_table.notes: lab_table knocked on its side as cover: top faces +Y, legs point -Y; ~140x55x70

pipe_cluster_wall.notes: 4 wall pipes + brackets running 256 along X (-128..128); WALL-MOUNTED: origin on the wall surface at the bottom of the brackets, pipes extend toward +Y (max 26). Tiles every 256

pipe_elbow.notes: 90 degree elbow, radius 8, bend radius 32: inlet at origin heading +X, outlet at (32,0,32) heading +Z. Origin on the pipe axis at the inlet flange

pipe_straight_256.notes: straight pipe, radius 8 (flanges 12), axis along X from -128 to +128; origin ON THE PIPE AXIS at its centre (kit snapping)

portable_lab.notes: trailer-style container lab 800x300x320 (long axis X), closed: windows + door (decal-like, not openable) on +Y with metal steps; wheels at -X, hitch/jack at +X

poster_safety.notes: 'SAFETY FIRST' poster 80x120; WALL decal: origin on the wall surface at the poster centre (place at ~150 high), 0.3 off the wall, no collision

power_cable_coil.notes: coiled heavy power cable on the floor (~70 dia, 12 high) with a tail running to +X and a plug; low, walk-over

sandbag_wall.notes: sandbag wall 200x60x90 (long axis X), staggered bags in two rows

satellite_dish.notes: 300 dia dish on a pedestal, aimed +Y and 35 deg up; ~330 tall

server_rack.notes: server rack 60x80x200 (front +Y) with blinking-light glow front

shelf_metal.notes: metal shelving 120x45x200, 4 shelves at z=12/72/132/192 (shelf collision per level so items can sit on them)

shelf_metal_stocked.notes: shelf_metal stocked with boxes, jars, cans and binders (no separate collision for contents)

sign_biohazard.notes: biohazard warning plate 60x60; WALL plate: origin on the wall surface at the sign centre (place at ~150-200 high)

sign_lambda.notes: orange lambda plate 60x60; WALL plate: origin on the wall surface at the sign centre (place at ~150-200 high)

sign_restricted.notes: 'RESTRICTED AREA / AUTHORIZED PERSONNEL ONLY' plate 120x60; WALL plate: origin on the wall surface at the sign centre (place at ~150-200 high)

sign_testchamber.notes: 'TEST CHAMBER / STARFALL RESEARCH SITE' plate 160x80; WALL plate: origin on the wall surface at the sign centre (place at ~150-200 high)

specimen_jar.notes: glass specimen jar 20 dia x 30 on a small metal stand; for tables/shelves

specimen_table.notes: lab_table with 3 specimen jars on top

terminal_standalone.notes: CRT terminal + keyboard for placing on tables/desks; screen faces +Y; glow screen

test_platform.notes: round raised metal test platform 300 dia x 20 with a ramped edge (walkable collision, hull); glowing ring lights; lambda emblem

test_target.notes: metal practice target dummy on a weighted stand, ~195 tall; target face toward +Y

vent_duct_256.notes: rectangular ceiling duct 64 wide x 48 tall along X (-128..128); CEILING-MOUNTED: origin on the ceiling surface, duct hangs from z=-10 to -58. Tiles every 256

wall_lamp.notes: caged wall lamp; WALL-MOUNTED: origin on the wall surface at the centre of the wall plate, lamp points +Y (out of the wall). Typical mount height 180-200. Add a LIGH at about (0,20,0)

whiteboard.notes: wall-mounted whiteboard 200x10x120 with equations; WALL-MOUNTED: origin on the wall surface AT FLOOR LEVEL, board spans z=80..200, extends to y=10 (tray)
